terms.meaning: A reusable piece of the screen that draws part of the page and reacts to user actions.
Information a component remembers while it is on screen, such as which suggestions were skipped.
Inputs passed into a component by the page that uses it.
A function given to another part of the code to run later, such as when the panel should close.
Curriculum vitae, the document describing a person's work history and skills.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and client marking
sections.what: Marks this as a browser-side component and loads the React state tool and the functions that read and save the profile.
sections.why: The panel must run in the browser because it reads and writes saved profile data.

sections.name: ProfileSuggestion
sections.title: Shape of one suggestion
sections.what: Defines what each suggestion holds: a kind (skill, certification, achievement, or voice note), a description for the user, and the value to add.
sections.why: Gives every suggestion the same fields so the panel can show and save them the same way.
sections.watch_out: A new kind added here must also be handled in the label and save steps, or it will fall through to the notes path.

sections.name: Props
sections.title: Inputs the panel accepts
sections.what: Lists the two inputs the panel needs: the suggestions to show and a function to call when the panel should close.
sections.why: Lets the parent page decide where suggestions come from and when to hide the panel.

sections.name: typeLabel
sections.title: Short tag for each kind
sections.what: Turns each suggestion kind into the short tag shown on its row, such as SKILL or CERT.
sections.why: Gives users a quick cue about what each suggestion will add.
sections.watch_out: A kind missing from this list would show no tag at all.

sections.name: applyToProfile
sections.title: Saving an accepted suggestion
sections.what: Saves one accepted suggestion: skills go into the Other category without duplicates, certifications become a new entry, and achievements or preferences are added to voice notes.
sections.why: Each kind of information is stored where the rest of the app already looks for it.
sections.watch_out: Skills go to any category whose name contains other, so an unrelated category could receive the skill.

sections.name: ProfileEnrichmentBanner (part 1)
sections.title: Tracking added and skipped suggestions
sections.what: Keeps track of which suggestions were added or skipped, hides the panel when none remain, and draws the header with the count and DISMISS ALL.
sections.why: Keeps each suggestion's status separate, so accepting one does not affect the others.
sections.watch_out: Suggestions are tracked by list position, so the list must not be reordered while the panel is open.

sections.name: ProfileEnrichmentBanner (part 2)
sections.title: Suggestion rows with add and skip buttons
sections.what: Draws each remaining suggestion with its tag, description, and value, plus ADD TO PROFILE and SKIP buttons.
sections.why: Lets the user act on each suggestion one at a time.
sections.watch_out: Skip only hides the row for this view and does not record the choice, so the suggestion can return later.

summary: A panel that shows suggested profile additions, such as skills or certifications, and lets the user add each one to the saved profile or skip it.
purpose: Lets the user review information the app found and choose what to keep, instead of typing it again by hand.
why: Likely reason: suggestions can be wrong, so the user confirms each one before anything is saved.
how: 1. The parent page passes in a list of suggestions and a close function. 2. The panel hides any suggestion the user has added or skipped. 3. When the user clicks ADD TO PROFILE, the suggestion is saved to the matching part of the profile: skills go to an Other category, certifications become a new entry, and achievements or preferences are added to voice notes. 4. The panel closes when the last suggestion is handled or when DISMISS ALL is clicked.
inputs: A list of suggestions, each with a kind, a description, and a value, plus a close function from the parent. It also reads the saved profile from storage.
outputs: Updates the saved profile when a suggestion is added. Shows nothing once all suggestions are handled or dismissed.
risks: Adding a certification sets its issuer to blank and its date to the day it was added, not the real date. Skipped items are only hidden in this view and return if the panel is shown again. If the profile editor is open elsewhere, its later saves can overwrite these additions.
debug: First confirm the saved profile changed in storage. If ADD does nothing, check whether a profile exists, because the save step returns early when none is found. If a skill lands in the wrong category, check the lookup, which matches any category whose name contains other in any letter case.
